launch_entries.name: Direct CLI (macapk-runtime --apk)
launch_entries.notes: Does NOT set the 4 MACAPK_EXPERIMENTAL_* rendering/looper flags, MACAPK_LOG_LEVEL, or MACAPK_QUIET_CLASSLOAD, and does NOT scrub harness vars.

launch_entries.name: Mac.apk Control Panel (direct Process + NSWorkspace.openApplication)
launch_entries.notes: Scrubs 9 harness variables at MacApkLauncherApp.init() (:153-161) and forces the 4 MACAPK_EXPERIMENTAL_* flags to 1 in both direct Process (:4510-4513) and NSWorkspace.openApplication (:4730-4733) before applying model.defaultEnv and app.env.

launch_entries.name: Installed App Stub / Dock Launch (AppStubMain.swift)
launch_entries.notes: Applies row.env from RegistryStore afterwards (setenv overwrite=1). Does NOT scrub the 9 harness vars that MacApkLauncherApp.swift scrubs.

launch_entries.name: System Broker (SystemBrokerMain.c + SystemServer.java)

sets_env.MACAPK_LOG_LEVEL: 7 (broker own process only; stripped before child spawn)

launch_entries.notes: Product mode spawns the app's installed stub (inherits AppStubMain defaults); dev mode via MACAPK_BROKER_RUNTIME spawns macapk-runtime --apk directly without setting the 4 MACAPK_EXPERIMENTAL_* flags, MACAPK_LOG_LEVEL=4, or MACAPK_QUIET_CLASSLOAD=1.

entry_mismatches.title: 4 MACAPK_EXPERIMENTAL_* defaults diverge between Launcher/Stub (=1) and direct runtime/broker dev spawns (unset -> OFF)
entry_mismatches.impact: Direct macapk-runtime --apk invocations and MACAPK_BROKER_RUNTIME dev broker spawns silently run with all 4 Surface/Choreo capabilities OFF, whereas Control Panel and Dock launches force all 4 ON. Handbook 8.7/12 describes them as production defaults (=0 disables) without documenting runtime's unset=OFF default.

entry_mismatches.title: MACAPK_LOG_LEVEL & MACAPK_QUIET_CLASSLOAD defaults differ across Launcher/Stub, direct runtime, and SystemServer spawns (+ stale level-5 comments)
entry_mismatches.impact: Control Panel (non-verbose) and Dock set MACAPK_LOG_LEVEL=4 + MACAPK_QUIET_CLASSLOAD=1; direct macapk-runtime and MACAPK_BROKER_RUNTIME spawns leave both unset (NativeLog floor 0 = emit all, android.util.Log floor 4 = INFO, QUIET_CLASSLOAD=false -> high classload log volume). NativeLog/Log comments still reference legacy level 5.

entry_mismatches.title: Harness environment scrubbing exists only in MacApkLauncherApp.swift, not in AppStubMain.swift or macapk-runtime
entry_mismatches.impact: 9 harness variables (MACAPK_NO_ACTIVATE, MACAPK_PAUSE_WHEN_HIDDEN, MACAPK_INSTALL_LOCK_HELD, MACAPK_INJECT_FILE, MACAPK_DEBUG_HOSTKEY_FILE, MACAPK_RECORD_INPUT, MACAPK_EXTERNAL_URLS, MACAPK_SYSTEM_APPS_DIR, MACAPK_USER_APPS_DIR) are unset by Control Panel startup only; Dock stub or direct CLI launched from a dirty shell inherits them.

entry_mismatches.title: PresentedSdk.java retains stale revert comments contradicting active MACAPK_SDK_FROM_TARGET=ON code
entry_mismatches.impact: Active code at :205 enables per-app targetSdk clamping whenever != "0" (default ON), while block comments at :94-96 and :241-270 claim it was reverted to opt-in (="1").

entry_mismatches.title: MACAPK_EXPERIMENTAL_ALPHA_PROBE uses =="1" in Java vs presence (!=null) in native C++/ObjC
entry_mismatches.impact: Setting MACAPK_EXPERIMENTAL_ALPHA_PROBE=0 disables the Java probe in SurfaceView.java but still activates native alpha probing in bionic_shim.cpp and cocoa_bridge.mm.
